canonical_claim: A source-selected normalized sequence of Hermite functions indexed by the natural numbers is a complete orthonormal family in the source-selected L^2 space on the real line.
domain_and_universes: Expected domain is the real line with Lebesgue measure and codomain real or complex scalars; the selected source must fix both and the concrete L2 quotient representation.

arbitrary vector/function in the selected L2 space for the completeness consequence
hypotheses: the precise normalized Hermite-function definition and measure convention selected from an immutable source

orthogonal complement of the span equals bottom
